features.missing_rule: Require exact 8h adjacency; never bridge or impute.
features.transform: log close and adjacent log return

features.availability_rule: Available with the same closed candle.
features.missing_rule: Require finite nonnegative values and at least 80% positive observations.

features.availability_rule: At least 14 eligible adjacent returns at each timestamp.
features.missing_rule: Missing below breadth 14; dependent candidates fail closed.

features.availability_rule: All windows end at the scheduled 00:00 UTC decision.
features.source: close returns, closes, and quote volume
features.transform: exclude >20% one-bar absolute return, >35% 21-bar absolute return, >45% drawdown, >0.70 log range, >1.50 annualized volatility, or insufficient positive volume

features.availability_rule: All 63 anchor candles are exactly adjacent and closed.
features.missing_rule: Exclude; also quarantine absolute residual distance above 0.15.
features.transform: latest log close minus quote-volume-weighted mean log close, then subtract cross-sectional median distance

features.availability_rule: Nine exact adjacent residual returns end at decision_time.
features.source: coin return minus cross-sectional market return
features.transform: sum divided by root sum of squares

features.availability_rule: Computed only at the 24h schedule after quarantine and robust cross-sectional transforms.
features.missing_rule: Flat below 12 scored coins, spread 0.75, or four scores on either side of +/-0.25.
features.transform: -robust_z(distance) + 0.25 * robust_z(confirmation), exposed once through strategy.score_boundary before selection

forbidden_inputs: transaction opens before A5 label construction
positions, equity, fills, PnL, results, private qualifier, or OOS data
